issues.title: Incorrect progress bar fill direction in RTL
issues.description: Progress indicators fill left-to-right rather than right-to-left.
issues.evidence: Filled white tracks on all cards originate from the left edge.
issues.suggestion: Reverse track fill origin to start from the inline start (right) in RTL mode.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: indicator used physical translateX(-X%) which always fills from the left edge; replaced with absolute inset-y-0 start-0 (inset-inline-start) + width % so fill starts at the inline-start edge (right in RTL).
